inputs.dataset: fixed author-generated wide.json and narrow.json; 65x65 grayscale unsigned 16-bit, 10 nm per synthetic pixel, expected SHA-256 and source revision; no upload
inputs.profile: X or Y through fixed pixel index 0–64, zero-based; center is 32/0 nm
inputs.validation: requires two bracketed crossings and contrast >=0.015 from the stored synthetic background

outputs.fields: image source IDs, hashes, pixel spacing, normalized line profiles, half height intercepts, widths, difference and ratio; JSON and CSV

limits: Synthetic data visualization and profile measurement only. No live instrument, measurements, operation, settings, modules, sample flows, biology or resolution prediction. No proven downstream consumer.
